quality_rule: Keep source_conflict/unresolved unless controlled evidence plus owner-worker and worker-6 gates later pass.
reason: Image evidence exists, but exact values require calibrated digitization and independent QA before any owner-worker can promote them.

qc_failure_reasons.reason: Primary local material supports figure-level dose-response and 20 ug/ml maximum effect/context but does not provide exact tabular EC50 or OD490 values; graph-derived estimates remain approximate.
DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP linked rows map to the three primary peptides, but exact activity values are database annotations not independently tabulated in the primary text/XML/PDF.

source_rework_targets.reason: The local XML/PDF and OA package contain Figure 4 curves and Figure 5 bar plots but no primary-source numeric data table for exact EC50, exact inhibition percentages at every concentration, or exact OD490 values. The merged database rows report EC50/percent-inhibition values, but those are database annotations rather than independent primary-source exact tables.
source_rework_targets.required_action: Keep paper non-accepted unless a future source adds primary tabular EC50/inhibition/OD490 values; do not promote database-only exact values to source_verified.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Peptide sequences, qualitative dose-response, 20 ug/ml maximum inhibitory/non-toxic context, and database cross-references are preserved, but exact database EC50 values cannot be upgraded to source_verified primary-text values; paper remains non-publication-grade under obtainable-only mode.
